title: Plant shape: coherent plants, or a mosaic?
question: Same bed, same everything. In one of these, each plant's shape is decided ONCE where it germinated, so the plant is one coherent thing; in the other, every cell of every plant rolled its own dice independently, so a plant is a mosaic of thousands of separate rolls. Every plant is still different in both. Does one read as more like a real plant to you -- or are they close enough that it is not worth having?
context_md: This is the middle of the dial: it keeps every plant distinct but makes each one internally consistent. It also moves heritability on plant size from 0.03 to ~0.34 -- less than dev=0's 0.65, but not the nothing that was predicted. Live in the lab as PARAMS -> HEREDITY -> shared_development = 2.

items.label: shipped (every cell rolls its own dice)
dev=1 (each plant one whole form, still all different)
